incidents-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency spike on /v1/chat/completions (route=chat-default, model=mistral-7b-32k). p99=2.1s (baseline ~450ms). paging @eng-oncall

maria: Oncall here. Looking now. Any customer-facing errors? I'll pull traces.

sam: i'm seeing increased tail latency on two routes: chat-default and chat-bot-prod. p95 jumped to ~800ms. error rate steady. kvcache hit rate down ~15%.

oliver: Is this correlated with a rollout or model swap? any deploys in the last hour?

maria: no deploys. spike started ~2961239800. region: eu-west-1. top affected orgs: org-42, org-88.

dana: product says org-42 reported timeouts in support thread — mild customer impact so far, not yet SLA breach but trending.

sam: propose temporary pager suppression + bump p99 alert threshold to 2.5s for 30m while we triage. keep ops-only alerts on.

maria: +1. also we should add a per-model/per-route p95/p99 panel to the live dashboard with overlay lines for current thresholds. i can spin that up.

oliver: i'll prepare an alert patch. will keep the page label off for now. patch draft:

```yaml
alert: ChatCompletionsLatencyP99
expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/chat/completions"}[5m])) by (le, model, route))
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: page
  route: chat-default
  model: mistral-7b-32k
annotations:
  summary: "p99 latency high for {{ $labels.route }} ({{ $labels.model }})"
  description: "Temporarily bumped threshold to 2.5s for 30m due to investigation. Revert if p99 > 3s."
thresholds:
  trigger: 2.5
  rollback: 3.0
suppress_pager_for: 30m
```

maria: i'll create INF ticket for post-incident and an alert audit (INF-XXXX). can someone confirm applying suppression?

sam: applying now to prometheus -> prometheus-alerts repo. will ping when done :white_check_mark:

incidents-bot: action: alert rule updated by sam at 2961239950

sam: done. suppression active until 2961241750. dashboard link: https://console.redwood/dashboards/latency-per-model-route

dana: notifying customer-success to proactively message org-42. cc @support-leads

maria: follow-ups:
- dashboard per-model/per-route (maria)
- run load replay for mistral-7b-32k on eu-west-1 (sam)
- inspect cache eviction and network metrics (oliver)
- alert audit & new baseline recommendations (maria)

oliver: i'll update the runbook to include quick-threshold-bump steps + clear rollback criteria.

sam: if p99 > 3.0s in next 15m we re-enable pager and escalate. otherwise keep suppressed and continue triage.

maria: ack. i'll post findings here as i dig in. :eyes:

dana: thanks team. i'll track comms with CS. :thumbsup:
